A.notes: The design relies heavily on a standard SaaS template approach, lacking a distinct identity or memorable concept. Furthermore, the 110px horizontal overflow on mobile represents a significant failure in basic responsive craft.

B.notes: An exceptionally strong and original take on a developer tool, using unexpected editorial typography (the bold serif italic) to create a highly memorable signature. The bespoke layout of the terminal mockups and flawless technical execution make it outstanding.

raw.why: Site B delivers a highly original, meticulously crafted design with a powerful typographic identity, whereas Site A is a generic template suffering from a major mobile layout bug.
